TrueAim Pro includes a native Leanback TV launcher banner and full support for cloud gaming services (GeForce NOW, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Boosteroid) on Android TV and Google TV.
No popup ads • No subscriptions • Pure gaming HUD
Unlike other crosshair apps that blast popups every 10 seconds, TrueAim Pro is built cleanly for the competitive mobile gaming community. Zero tracking, zero ads, zero battery hogging.
Android requires \'Display over other apps\' permission so your custom crosshair can float transparently on top of your favorite games.

TrueAim Pro is a pure visual screen overlay tool. It does NOT modify game memory, inject code, alter network packets, or auto-aim. It simply provides an on-screen reference point just like physical monitor crosshairs.

Android requires the special \'Display over other apps\' permission so your crosshair HUD can float transparently over games without intercepting touch input.
In Android\'s \'Display over other apps\' list, tap TrueAim Pro and turn ON \'Allow display over other apps\'. Practice on the interactive switch above!
Once enabled, return to TrueAim Pro and activate the Master Overlay Switch to project your calibrated crosshair in real-time.
